verses.en: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
verses.pt: E enquanto Apolo estava em Corinto, aconteceu que, tendo Paulo passado por todas as regiões altas, ele veio a Éfeso; e achando ali alguns discípulos,
verses.en_web: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus, and found certain disciples.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having gone through the higher country, came to Ephesus, where there were certain disciples:

verses.en: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes: Vós já recebestes o Espírito Santo desde que crestes? E eles lhe disseram: Nós nem tínhamos ouvido falar que havia Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Did you get the Holy Spirit when you had faith? And they said to him, No, we have had no knowledge of the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John’s baptism.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Em que vós fostes batizados? E eles disseram: No batismo de João.
verses.en_web: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, What sort of baptism did you have? And they said, The baptism of John.

verses.en: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Então Paulo disse: João verdadeiramente batizou com o batismo do arrependimento, dizendo ao povo que cressem naquele que viria após ele, isto é, em Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Jesus.”
verses.en_bbe: And Paul said, John gave a baptism which goes with a change of heart, saying to the people that they were to have faith in him who was coming after him, that is, in Jesus.

verses.en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.pt: Ao ouvirem isto, eles foram batizados no nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing this, they had baptism in the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
verses.pt: E Paulo, impondo-lhes as mãos, veio sobre eles o Espírito Santo; e falavam em línguas, e profetizavam.
verses.en_web: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.
verses.en_bbe: And when Paul had put his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them; and they had the power of talking in tongues, and acting like prophets.

verses.en: And all the men were about twelve.
verses.pt: E todos os homens eram cerca de doze.
verses.en_web: They were about twelve men in all.
verses.en_bbe: And there were about twelve of these men.

verses.en: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: E ele, entrando na sinagoga, falava ousadamente durante três meses, disputando e persuadindo as coisas do Reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: He entered into the synagogue, and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And he went into the Synagogue, and for three months he was preaching there without fear, reasoning and teaching about the kingdom of God.

verses.en: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
verses.pt: Mas quando alguns se endureceram, e não creram, e falando mal do Caminho diante da multidão, ele se desviou deles; e separou aos discípulos, disputando a cada dia na escola de um certo Tirano.
verses.en_web: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
verses.en_bbe: But because some of the people were hard-hearted and would not give hearing, saying evil words about the Way before the people, he went away from them, and kept the disciples separate, reasoning every day in the school of Tyrannus.

verses.en: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.pt: E isto aconteceu durante dois anos; de tal maneira que todos os que habitavam na Ásia tinham ouvido a palavra do Senhor Jesus, tanto judeus como gregos.
verses.en_web: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.en_bbe: And this went on for two years, so that all those who were living in Asia had knowledge of the word of the Lord, Greeks as well as Jews.

verses.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
verses.pt: E Deus fazia milagres extraordinários pelas mãos de Paulo,
verses.en_web: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
verses.en_bbe: And God did special works of power by the hands of Paul:

verses.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verses.pt: De tal maneira que até os lenços e aventais de seu corpo eram levados aos enfermos, e as doenças os deixavam, e os espíritos malignos saíam deles.
verses.en_web: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
verses.en_bbe: So that bits of linen and clothing from his body were taken to people who were ill, and their diseases went away from them and the evil spirits went out.

verses.en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
verses.pt: E alguns exorcistas dos judeus, itinerantes, tentaram invocar o nome do Senhor Jesus sobre os que tinham espíritos malignos, dizendo: Nós vos repreendemos por Jesus, a quem Paulo prega.
verses.en_web: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
verses.en_bbe: But some of the Jews who went from place to place driving out evil spirits, took it on themselves to make use of the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, I give you orders, by Jesus, whom Paul is preaching.

verses.en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
verses.pt: E eram sete filhos de Ceva, judeu, chefe dos sacerdotes, os que faziam isto.
verses.en_web: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
verses.en_bbe: And there were seven sons of a man named Sceva, a Jew and a chief priest, who did this.

verses.en: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
verses.pt: Mas o espírito maligno respondeu: Eu conheço Jesus, e sei quem é Paulo; mas vós, quem sois?
verses.en_web: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
verses.en_bbe: And the evil spirit, answering, said to them, I have knowledge of Jesus, and of Paul, but who are you?

verses.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.pt: E o homem em quem estava o espírito maligno saltou sobre eles, e dominando-os, foi mais forte do que eles; de tal maneira que eles fugiram nus e feridos daquela casa.
verses.en_web: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.en_bbe: And the man in whom the evil spirit was, jumping on them, was stronger than the two of them, and overcame them, so that they went running from that house, wounded and without their clothing.

verses.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.pt: E isto se fez conhecido a todos que habitavam em Éfeso, tanto a judeus como a gregos; e caiu temor sobre todos eles; e assim foi engrandecido o nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.en_bbe: And this came to the ears of all those, Jews and Greeks, who were living at Ephesus; and fear came on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was made great.

verses.en: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
verses.pt: E muitos dos que criam vinham, confessando e declararando as suas atitudes.
verses.en_web: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.
verses.en_bbe: And a number of those who had faith came and made a public statement of their sins and all their acts.

verses.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.pt: Também muitos dos que praticavam ocultismo trouxeram seus livros, e os queimaram na presença de todos; e calcularam o preço deles, e acharam que custavam cinquenta mil moedas de prata.
verses.en_web: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.en_bbe: And a great number of those who were experts in strange arts took their books and put them on the fire in front of everyone: and when the books were valued they came to fifty thousand bits of silver.

verses.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
verses.pt: Assim a palavra do Senhor crescia e prevalecia poderosamente.
verses.en_web: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
verses.en_bbe: So the word of the Lord was increased very greatly and was full of power.

verses.en: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
verses.pt: E quando se cumpriram estas coisas, Paulo propôs em espírito que, passando pela Macedônia e Acaia, ir até Jerusalém, dizendo: Depois de eu estar lá, também tenho que ver Roma.
verses.en_web: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”
verses.en_bbe: Now after these things were ended, Paul came to a decision that when he had gone through Macedonia and Achaia he would go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I have a desire to see Rome.

verses.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
verses.pt: E ele, tendo enviado à Macedônia dois daqueles que o serviam, Timóteo e Erasto, ele ficou por algum tempo na Ásia.
verses.en_web: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
verses.en_bbe: And having sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, into Macedonia, he himself went on living in Asia for a time.

verses.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
verses.pt: Mas naquele tempo aconteceu um não pequeno alvoroço quanto ao Caminho.
verses.en_web: About that time there arose no small stir concerning the Way.
verses.en_bbe: And about that time a great outcry took place about the Way.

verses.en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
verses.pt: Porque um certo artífice de prata, de nome Demétrio, que fazia objetos de prata para o templo de Diana, e dava não pouco lucro aos artesãos.
verses.en_web: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
verses.en_bbe: For there was a certain man named Demetrius, a silver-worker, who made silver boxes for the images of Diana, and gave no small profit to the workmen;

verses.en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
verses.pt: Aos quais, tendo os reunido com os trabalhadores de semelhantes coisas, disse: Homens, vós sabeis que deste ofício temos nossa prosperidade.
verses.en_web: whom he gathered together, with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.
verses.en_bbe: Whom he got together, with other workmen of the same trade, and said to them, Men, it is clear that from this business we get our wealth.

verses.en: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
verses.pt: E vós estais vendo e ouvindo que este Paulo, não somente em Éfeso, mas até quase em toda a Ásia, tem persuadido e apartado uma grande multidão, dizendo que não são deuses os que são feitos com as mãos.
verses.en_web: You see and hear, that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods, that are made with hands.
verses.en_bbe: And you see, for it has come to your ears, that not only at Ephesus, but almost all through Asia, this Paul has been teaching numbers of people and turning them away, saying that those are not gods who are made by men's hands:

verses.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
verses.pt: E não somente há perigo de que isto torne nosso ofício em desprezo, mas também que até o tempo da grande deusa Diana seja considerado inútil, e que a grandiosidade dela, a quem toda a Ásia e o mundo venera, venha a ser destruída.
verses.en_web: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing, and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”
verses.en_bbe: And there is danger, not only that our trade may be damaged in the opinion of men, but that the holy place of the great goddess Diana may be no longer honoured, and that she to whom all Asia and the world give worship, will be put down from her high position.

verses.en: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.pt: E eles, ao ouvirem estas coisas,encheram-se de ira, e clamaram, dizendo: Grande é a Diana dos efésios!
verses.en_web: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
verses.en_bbe: And hearing this, they were very angry, crying out and saying, Great is Diana of Ephesus.

verses.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
verses.pt: E toda a cidade se encheu de tumulto, e em concordância eles invadiram ao teatro, tomando consigo Gaio e Aristarco, macedônios, companheiros de Paulo na viagem.
verses.en_web: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.
verses.en_bbe: And the town was full of noise and trouble, and they all came running into the theatre, having taken by force Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia who were journeying in company with Paul.

verses.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
verses.pt: E Paulo, querendo comparecer diante do povo, os discípulos não o permitiram.
verses.en_web: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
verses.en_bbe: And when Paul was about to go in to the people, the disciples did not let him.

verses.en: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
verses.pt: E também alguns dos líderes da Ásia, que eram amigos dele, enviaram-lhe aviso, rogando -lhe para que não se apresentasse no teatro.
verses.en_web: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
verses.en_bbe: And some of the rulers of Asia, being his friends, sent to him, requesting him seriously not to put himself in danger by going into the theatre.

verses.en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
verses.pt: Então gritavam, alguns de uma maneira, outros de outra; porque a aglomeração estava confusa; e a maioria não sabia por que causa estavam aglomerados.
verses.en_web: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.
verses.en_bbe: And some said one thing, and some another: for there was no order in the meeting; and most of them had no idea why they had come together.

verses.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
verses.pt: E tiraram da multidão a Alexandre, os judeus o pondo para a frente. E Alexandre, acenando com a mão, queria se defender ao povo.
verses.en_web: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
verses.en_bbe: Then they took Alexander out from among the people, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander, making a sign with his hand, was about to make a statement to the people in answer:

verses.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.pt: Mas ao saberem que ele era judeu, levantou-se uma voz de todos, clamando por cerca de duas horas: Grande é a Diana dos efésios!
verses.en_web: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
verses.en_bbe: But when they saw that he was a Jew, all of them with one voice went on crying out for about two hours, Great is Diana of Ephesus.

verses.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
verses.pt: E o escrivão, tendo apaziguado a multidão, disse: Homens efésios, quem não sabe que a cidade dos efésios é a guardadora do templo da grande deusa Diana, e da imagem que desceu do céu?
verses.en_web: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
verses.en_bbe: And when the chief secretary had got the people quiet, he said, Men of Ephesus, is any man without knowledge that the town of Ephesus is the keeper of the holy place of the great Diana, who was sent down from Jupiter?

verses.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
verses.pt: Portanto, sendo que estas coisas não podem ser contraditas, vós deveis vos acalmar, e nada façais precipitadamente;
verses.en_web: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rash.
verses.en_bbe: So then, because these things may not be doubted, it would be better for you to be quiet, and do nothing unwise.

verses.en: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.pt: Porque vós trouxestes aqui estes homens, que nem são sacrílegos, nem blasfemam de vossa deusa.
verses.en_web: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.en_bbe: For you have taken these men, who are not doing damage to the holy place or talking against our goddess.

verses.en: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
verses.pt: Então se Demétrio e os artesãos que estão com ele tem algum assunto contra ele, os tribunais estão abertos, e há procônsules; que se acusem uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open, and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.
verses.en_bbe: If, then, Demetrius and the workmen who are with him have a protest to make against any man, the law is open to them, and there are judges; let them put up a cause at law against one another.

verses.en: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
verses.pt: E se procurais alguma outra coisa, será decidido em uma reunião legalizada.
verses.en_web: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
verses.en_bbe: But if any other business is in question, let it be taken up in the regular meeting.

verses.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day’s uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
verses.pt: Porque corremos perigo de que hoje sejamos acusados de rebelião, tendo causa nenhuma para dar como explicação para este tumulto.
verses.en_web: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”
verses.en_bbe: For, truly, we are in danger of being made responsible for this day's trouble, there being no cause for it: and we are not able to give any reason for this coming together.

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.pt: E tendo dito isto, despediu o ajuntamento.
verses.en_web: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had said this, he sent the meeting away.
